# verify — the agent workflow's checks, enforced by CI on every PR.
# Mirrors what the pre-commit hook and the review skill require locally.
name: verify

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21

      - name: Validate skills against the Agent Skills spec
        run: bash .agents/skills/review/scripts/validate-skills.sh

      - name: Validate contracts
        run: bash .agents/skills/review/scripts/validate-contracts.sh

      - name: Secret scan (all tracked files)
        run: git ls-files -z | xargs -0 bash .agents/skills/review/scripts/scan-secrets.sh

      - name: Proof — TypeScript (primary demo)
        run: node --test "tests-ts/**/*.test.ts"

      - name: Proof — Python
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests

      - name: Proof — Java
        run: mvn -q -f java-demo/pom.xml test

      - name: Packet freshness — TypeScript
        run: bash .agents/skills/review/scripts/collect-evidence.sh --verify

      - name: Packet freshness — Python
        run: CONTRACT=references/contract-py.md PROOF_CMD="python3 -m unittest discover -s tests" PACKET=pr-packet-py.md bash .agents/skills/review/scripts/collect-evidence.sh --verify

      - name: Packet freshness — Java
        run: CONTRACT=references/contract-java.md PROOF_CMD="mvn -q -f java-demo/pom.xml test" PACKET=pr-packet-java.md bash .agents/skills/review/scripts/collect-evidence.sh --verify
